title: Adjunct Lecturer in Public Policy
bio: James Geary is an Adjunct Lecturer in Public Policy at Harvard Kennedy School. He has taught at the VII Foundation, Bennington College, Boston University, Brandeis University, the Faber Academy, Tufts University, and the Harvard Extension School, and he has been an Ida Beam Visiting Professor at the University of Iowa.
